about: A reviewer's answer and the verdict read from it: the first line that starts (after spaces or tabs, and after an optional markdown heading mark and emphasis: `## `, `**`, `__`, `*`, `_`) with the whole word VERIFIED or REJECTED (not followed by a letter, a digit, `_` or `/`), optionally after `NARROW:`. `line` is that line from the word on, its markup dropped (the closing emphasis right after the word, after the word and its colon, or at the end of the line); `text` is `line` and the rest of the answer after it. `verdict: null` means no verdict. The Harness reader (harness/lib/verdict.cjs) and the worfy app's copy (src/shared/workflow/verdict.mjs) must agree on every case. `grader` is what the grader rejected-first of the eval case reviewer-verdict says of the answer: it is strict where the readers are lenient, and passes only a bare `REJECTED:` line, lines before it skipped.
